title: A tier's Pricing tab shows how each matrix prices it, in the grid's words
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, whose name starts with A, with Separate Part Sale pricing off, tier A 10% off in every range.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B, whose name starts with B, with tier A on Same as previous tier.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix C, whose name starts with C, with Separate Part Sale pricing on, tier A 35% markup on the Part Sale side.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix D, whose name starts with D, tier A on Margin % with 30 in one range and 25 in the other.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Each matrix row shows its name with its categories under it, a Work Order Matrix value and a Part Sale Matrix value.
  • The General Matrix is first, then matrix A, matrix B, matrix C and matrix D in A to Z order.
  • Matrix A's Work Order Matrix value reads 10% off.
  • Matrix B's reads Uses previous tier.
  • Matrix D's reads % margin (two different values).
  • Matrix A's and matrix B's Part Sale Matrix values read Same as work orders.
  • Matrix C's Part Sale Matrix value reads 35% markup.
